incident.symptom: A newly reauthorized LinkedIn token passed member health but company publication was treated as unavailable because LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO returned 403.
incident.root_cause: The company preflight incorrectly coupled organization write readiness to r_organization_admin/ACL-read capability. LinkedIn write and organization-read capabilities are distinct.
incident.prior_working_evidence: Bedrijfsgeheugen previously received a successful LinkedIn provider create URN while exact organization readback remained permission-limited.

prevention: Use canonical organization URN urn:li:organization:18234216 as company author authority unless explicitly configured otherwise.
Treat LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO as optional corroboration, not a company write prerequisite.
Treat provider create as the authoritative write-capability probe when scope metadata is absent.
401/REVOKED_ACCESS_TOKEN triggers reauthorization; 403 on organization read alone does not.
Persist successful create URN immediately and forbid republishing.
